signalling_question (Yes/No/Unclear): Is the provenance of the OT traffic stated (physical testbed, operational site, simulation, generated) and the capture point described?
Does benign traffic cover more than one operating mode or a duration long enough to include routine changes?
Were inappropriate exclusions avoided (no removal of hard-to-classify records before evaluation)?
Is attack traffic generated independently of the detector design?
Was the decision threshold or operating point fixed before evaluation on the test data?
Are the detector's inputs obtainable by a receive-only sensor at the stated observation point at inference time?
If the architecture is hybrid, is the passive component's output reported separately?
Is the detector compared with an appropriate baseline on the same data?
Are ground-truth labels derived from an attack log or execution record rather than from the detector or post-hoc inspection?
Are label boundaries in time defined at the level of the decision unit?
Were labels assigned without knowledge of the detector's results?
Are training and test data separated in time, run or session?
Are scaling, feature selection and resampling fitted on training data only?
Are all test decision units included in the reported metrics?
Is the attack denominator stated as distinct attacks or scenarios?
Is the evaluated traffic representative of an operational OT network?
Can the detector run off-path as described, within sensor resources, with operator-usable latency?
Do the labelled attacks correspond to operationally relevant ATT&CK for ICS techniques?

domain: Judgement rule: Low if all questions Yes; High if any No without mitigation; otherwise Unclear. "Not established in extraction" = Unclear.
